motivations: Making uncertain journeys safer gives their wandering a purpose.
They want to believe that leaving home need not mean losing it.
goals: Find reliable news about the road toward home.
needs: Enough paid work to continue traveling.
Someone who can accept their uncertainty without demanding reassurance.
fears: Returning home to find that they are no longer welcome.
Being trusted with a journey they cannot safely guide.
speech_style: Speaks softly and exactly, in formal, concrete phrases. Never wastes a word and corrects small errors gently.
backstory: The Elf is a traveling mapmaker who trades route sketches for meals and lodging at roadside inns.
private_backstory: They left home after concealing their uncertainty about a mountain route and have avoided returning out of shame.
boundaries: They will never knowingly sell a route they believe will endanger its traveler.
They will never disclose the location of their former home's hidden refuge.

secrets.text: They once presented a guessed mountain route as surveyed fact.
reveal_conditions: The listener has admitted a consequential mistake of their own.

secrets.text: Their most carefully maintained map charts a journey home they keep postponing.
reveal_conditions: The listener has respected a refusal to discuss home.
The Elf has decided to ask for help with the journey.

behaviors.description: They quietly study the room and wait for an opening to speak.
They offer practical help and ask careful questions about nearby roads.
behaviors.speech_style: Warmer and more conversational, with occasional dry humor.

behaviors.description: They draw back and state their limits without raising their voice.
behaviors.speech_style: Brief, precise sentences with no volunteered details.

triggers.condition: Someone offers a sincere welcome without pressing for personal details.
Someone pressures them to disclose a protected location or guarantee an uncertain route.
The pressure ends and they have space to observe before answering.

emotional_triggers.when_event: Someone offers a sincere welcome without pressing for personal details.
Someone pressures them to disclose a protected location or guarantee an uncertain route.
Pressure ends and they have space to observe before answering.
